name: DeepL
label: DeepL
description: Official DeepL API (translate v2, glossaries + languages v3) on INPUT input → OUTPUT output. Default host is Pro https://api.deepl.com. Free plan uses https://api-free.deepl.com (OfficialApiNode has one baseUrl). Auth is StudioQuack secret auth_key sent as Authorization DeepL-Auth-Key. Docs: https://developers.deepl.com/docs/getting-started/auth. Terms: https://www.deepl.com/pro-license. Never log auth_key.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. operation overrides the instance Operation when set. translate requires text + target_lang. glossary_create requires name (+ dictionaries or entries). languages accepts resource. Do not put auth_key here. Example: {"operation":"translate","text":"Hello","target_lang":"DE"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: translate | glossary_create | glossary_list | languages. Overrides instance Operation when set. translate = POST /v2/translate; glossary_create = POST /v3/glossaries; glossary_list = GET /v3/glossaries; languages = GET /v3/languages. Example: languages.

schema.label: text
schema.description: translate body text. String or JSON array of UTF-8 strings. Empty → error, no HTTP. Provider cap 128 KiB.

schema.label: target_lang
schema.description: translate target, e.g. DE, EN-US, EN-GB, PT-BR, ZH-HANS. Also first-dictionary target on glossary_create.

schema.label: source_lang
schema.description: Optional source. Required by DeepL when glossary_id is set (no auto-detect with glossaries).

schema.label: formality
schema.description: Overrides config. EXACT: default | more | less | prefer_more | prefer_less.

schema.label: entries
schema.description: TSV (Hello\tGuten Tag) or CSV per entries_format when not sending dictionaries[].

schema.label: dictionaries
schema.description: v3 dictionaries array {source_lang, target_lang, entries, entries_format}.

schema.label: resource
schema.description: languages query. Default translate_text. Allowed: translate_text | glossary (other resources exist but are out of catalog scope).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (translations, glossaries, or languages). HTTP 456 = quota exceeded. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx/201. Absent on failure.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official DeepL verb. EXACT: translate | glossary_create | glossary_list | languages. Default translate = POST /v2/translate.

configurationParameters.label: Auth Key
configurationParameters.description: DeepL authentication key. Sent as Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key {auth_key}. StudioQuack secret only. Never logged. Free keys end with :fx — use host https://api-free.deepl.com (this node defaults to Pro https://api.deepl.com).

configurationParameters.label: Formality
configurationParameters.description: Default translate formality when input omits it. EXACT: default | more | less | prefer_more | prefer_less.
